notes: The closed lifecycle and classification laws are moved to src/mncs_commons/mesh/mncs/commons/pressure/lifecycle.mncs. This record tracks the remaining dynamic projection boundary, not unavoidable filesystem transport.

reproducer.attemptedProgram: mncs 0.16; module commons.pressure.projection; query dynamic JSON records by target/domain/status and fold an unbounded observation map
reproducer.expected: The capability is not representable as a general native MNCS program with current collections, dynamic text, JSON, and host-effect boundaries.

requiredBehavior: A native Commons semantic layer should classify pressure projections, fold bounded event/observation collections, and expose deterministic query predicates over structured records without re-implementing the rules in a host language.
summary: PressureRegistry query, validation, relationship folding, and deterministic view materialization operate over unbounded JSON records, dynamic strings, maps/sets, and append-only event collections. Current MNCS can express the closed lifecycle decision kernel, but cannot host this dynamic projection semantics without a Python adapter.
title: Dynamic registry projection cannot yet be native MNCS
